title: ToolSpecKind
description:
Coarse classification of a discoverable tool.

Wire mirror of the engine's `domain::ToolKind`; defined as a separate type so that the discovery and display concerns can evolve independently. Zero-cost conversion from [`ToolKind`] is provided via [`From`].

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::ToolSpecKind; let v = serde_json::to_value(ToolSpecKind::Read).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v, "read"); let back: ToolSpecKind = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, ToolSpecKind::Read); ```
